profile.headline: Retired
profile.summary: I have developed in C#.Net ,VB.Net & ASP.NET using frameworks beta 2 - 4.7 starting in 09/2001 to present.  Completed full development, testing and deployment cycle in both Agile, Kanban and Waterfall projects for .NET, ASP.NET, MVC,MVVC, WPF and WCF applications.  Held multiple roles including Consultant, Designer and Developer for several Intranet and Internet web-sites using ASP.NET, SQL Server and Oracle.   Experience in medical, banking, insurance, construction and manufacturing industries.  Able to maintain productive working relationships with both management and team members.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Modifying existing software to work in multi-site environment

company.name: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Nebraska

positions.title: Sr. .Net Developer
positions.description: I worked on team that simplified setup and viewing of SSRS reports through a web interface.  I built a WebApi that accessed information from the SSRS web service and Sql Server database (Entity Framework) to provide information to the end user.  This enabled user to open reports, set parameters and setup subscriptions.  I also create a console app that read a JSON manifest to deploy reports to server.  This included setting up datasources, folders permissions and deploying rdl files.

positions.title: Senior Contract Programmer
positions.description: Worked to automate manufacturing processing to a tablet based system (Windows Store app) interfacing with SAP, Sql server express through WCF services and Metro application using MVVC, WPF, WCF and XMAL.  Created several windows applications for internal processes. Created  responsive web design apps (Bootstrap and FooTable) using both windows forms and MVC

positions.title: Contract Programmer
positions.description:
I have completed several projects using .NET 3.5, 4.0,4.5.2 FluentNHibernate, Entity Framework, Windsor Castle, Unity Framework, SQL Server 2005& 2008, 2012. Written Windows Services, MVC Web Services, Web based as well as Windows applications using VB & C#.NET. 
I have worked remote for the last 3 years. All projects implemented an Agile approach with daily stand up meetings and constant contact with other team members.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description: Created application that aggregated credit reports from 3 agencies, and summarized all data in XML format for underwriters final approval using VB.NET 3.5 and MySql.

positions.title: Application Programmer
positions.description: Worked as developer on Enterprise Architect Team to design and implement a data warehousing solutions. This was an Agile project with daily standup meetings. Used .NET 2.0, 3.5, SQL Server 2005, Subversion, NHibernate, Mass Transit, MBUnit, RhinoMocks.

positions.title: Application Programmer
positions.description:
Web based application to maintain employee information using ASP.NET 2.0.
Designed and wrote web service for retrieving images from 3rd party imaging system.
Custom modules for additional functionality in DotNetNuke 4.05.05
Wrote stored procedures and functions in MS SQL Server 2005

positions.title: Application Programmer
positions.description:
Extracted data from Oracle database using PL/SQL for communication with Morning Star web site.  The PL/SQL contained all business logic for process.
Wrote console app which consumed web services to creating XML according to Morning Star Schema.

positions.title: Application Programmer
positions.description: First PC programmer hired.  Recommended and assisted the move to the .NET environment. Wrote  several .NET Windows Services, ASP.NET Web services and ASP.NET Web applications to enhance productivity in the company’s primary function of third party insurance administration.
